description: Fabric mod that lets an AI (Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Ollama...) play your Minecraft character to complete goals you give it.

mods.name: MineAgent
mods.description: Lets an AI play your character: give it a goal and it walks, mines, crafts, smelts and fights to reach it. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Gemini, Ollama and other OpenAI-compatible APIs.

releases.notes:
**New**
- Settings screen: every setting now lives in a screen opened from Mod Menu or with `/agent config`, with General, Providers and Display tabs. Options that don't apply to the chosen provider are greyed out or hidden, and it warns when a key, model or base URL is missing.
- Questions: the model can ask you a question with clickable answers (`ask_player`) and waits for your reply. Answer by clicking, with `[Type an answer]`, or with `/agent answer`.
- minecraft.wiki: a new `wiki` tool looks up a page and reads its introduction or one section, such as "Obtaining". It can be turned off in the settings.
- Server TPS: the model is told the server's ticks per second in `observe` and warned when the server lags. On a remote server the rate is estimated and marked as such.
- The status box can be moved to any corner with an offset, for example to keep it clear of a minimap.

**Fixes**
- Eating works while chat or another screen is open. It used to fail with "did not finish".
- Gathering logs or ore finishes the tree or vein it started instead of walking off to another one after the lowest blocks.

**Changed**
- The setting commands (`/agent provider`, `model`, `baseurl`, `vision`, `commands`, `effort` and the others) are removed; use the settings screen. Cloth Config is bundled, and Mod Menu is optional.
- Tested with Sodium, Iris and Lithium installed.

Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, Fabric API and Java 25.

mods.name: MineAgent
mods.description: Lets an AI play your character: give it a goal and it walks, mines, crafts, smelts and fights to reach it. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Gemini, Ollama and other OpenAI-compatible APIs.

releases.notes:
**New**
- Waypoints: with Xaero's Minimap or JourneyMap installed, the new `waypoints` tool lists the player's waypoints in the current dimension (nearest first, with a name filter) and adds new ones, so goals like "go back to my base" work without coordinates.
- Recipe viewers: with REI or JEI installed, `recipes` also lists every other kind of recipe that makes an item, such as smelting, a Farmer's Delight cooking pot or another mod's machine, with the block that makes it and the ingredients. A `craft` that finds no crafting recipe says where the item is made instead.
- The model is told which installed mods add content (namespace, name, and how many blocks, items and entity types each adds), and that modded ids work with every tool.
- `craft` uses crafting tables from other mods, `smelt` uses modded furnaces, and the other workstation tools accept modded variants of their station.

**Fixes**
- Furnaces are loaded with the right amount of modded fuel. The estimate used to be a fixed list of vanilla fuels, so any modded fuel was treated as the weakest one and loaded several times over.

Xaero's Minimap, JourneyMap, REI and JEI are all optional. EMI has no 26.3 build yet, so it is not supported.

Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, Fabric API and Java 25.

mods.name: MineAgent
mods.description: Lets an AI play your character: give it a goal and it walks, mines, crafts, smelts and fights to reach it. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Gemini, Ollama and other OpenAI-compatible APIs.

releases.notes:
**New**
- `teleport` moves the player with `/tp` when the server allows it (cheats in singleplayer, operator on a server), with no need for `/agent commands on`. It refuses spots inside blocks and, for a player who cannot fly, spots above a fall of more than 3 blocks.
- `face` turns the player's head toward a block, an entity, a compass direction or a yaw/pitch angle, so the model can aim `use_item` after moving. `look` accepts the same targets, and `observe` shows yaw and pitch.
- Walking is faster and smoother: the walker cuts straight across open ground, strafes while turning instead of stopping at each corner, and sprints on clear stretches. A 60-block test course went from 16 to under 11 seconds.
- `walk_to` opens wooden doors and fence gates instead of breaking them, climbs ladders and vines, and drops up to 32 blocks into water.
- The model is told about advancements the player completes during a goal.

**Fixes**
- Path searches no longer freeze the game: each one is spread over several ticks, and long trips are planned leg by leg as chunks load. A search toward an unloaded area used to take about half a second within a single tick, so a run of re-plans stalled the game for seconds.
- Chunks the server has not sent are no longer mistaken for open air, which made flights plan through terrain that had not loaded yet.
- The walker no longer jumps whenever it brushes a wall.
- The player no longer spins in place while flying. A flight to a spot inside a block or in a closed room fails at once with the reason, instead of hovering and searching for 20 seconds.
- Some lines of the model's instructions contained stray tab characters.

Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, Fabric API and Java 25.

mods.name: MineAgent
mods.description: Lets an AI play your character: give it a goal and it walks, mines, crafts, smelts and fights to reach it. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Gemini, Ollama and other OpenAI-compatible APIs.

releases.notes:
**New**
- Creative tools: `fly_to` flies along a route through open air and lands or hovers, `fly` takes off or lands in place, and `give_item` takes any item from the creative menu. `walk_to` and other tools that walk come down to the ground first.
- `run_command` runs server commands the player is allowed to use and returns the server's replies. It is off until `/agent commands on`, refuses client-side mod commands such as `/agent`, and with it the model builds and clears areas with `fill` and `setblock`.
- Workstation tools: `stonecut`, `smith` (netherite upgrades and trims), `anvil` (combine, repair, rename), `enchant` (list the three offers, then take one), `grindstone` and `brew`.
- `look` sends the model a screenshot of the player's view, with the HUD hidden. It is only offered to models that read images: MineAgent checks the model with Anthropic, Mistral, xAI, OpenRouter, Ollama and DeepSeek where they publish it, and `/agent vision on|off|auto` overrides that. If a model rejects a screenshot anyway, the goal carries on without it and the model is remembered as text-only.
- When a mob attacks the player, the agent fights back on its own, then resumes what it was doing.
- The agent's chat messages render Markdown: bold, italic, `__underline__`, strikethrough, code, headings, lists and clickable links.
- `observe` reports whether the player can fly, use creative items and run commands. Item descriptions name potion types and enchantments.

**Fixes**
- A walk that resumes after a reflex pause plans a new path instead of following the old one from the wrong place.

Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, Fabric API and Java 25.

releases.notes:
**New**
- `inventory` tool: the agent can list every slot, move an item to any hotbar, inventory or offhand slot (a shield or torches in the offhand, a pickaxe in hotbar 1), and tidy up: merge partial stacks and put its weapon, tools, food, torches and building blocks in fixed hotbar slots.
- `/agent toolchat on` posts every tool call and its result in chat, with the full result on hover. Off by default; every call is also written to the game log.

**Fixes**
- Dropped items no longer land on the player and get picked straight back up. The agent throws them a few blocks ahead, leaves its own drops alone, and refuses to drop tools, weapons or armor unless it explicitly forces it.

Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, Fabric API and Java 25.

mods.name: MineAgent
mods.description: Lets an AI play your character: give it a goal and it walks, mines, crafts, smelts and fights to reach it. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Gemini, Ollama and other OpenAI-compatible APIs.

releases.notes:
**New**
- The agent's path is drawn in the world while it walks: a cyan line to the destination (green box), red outlines on blocks it will break, yellow where it will pillar up. Toggle with `/agent showpath on|off`.
- Goals no longer end at the turn limit. The agent pauses, gives you control back, and posts **[Continue]** and **[Stop]** buttons in chat. `/agent continue <n>` allows a specific number of turns. The conversation carries on where it left off.
- The status box at the top left shows the tokens used so far.

**Fixes**
- The agent no longer drowns. Between actions it treads water at the surface; during an action it swims up for air when it runs low, mining a block overhead if needed. Paths avoid long underwater stretches.
- After a death, the agent is told whether it kept its items (read from the `keep_inventory` game rule in singleplayer, and from the respawned inventory on servers) instead of guessing.

Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, Fabric API and Java 25.

mods.name: MineAgent
mods.description: Lets an AI play your character: give it a goal and it walks, mines, crafts, smelts and fights to reach it. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Gemini, Ollama and other OpenAI-compatible APIs.

releases.notes:
**New**
- After each action, the agent is told how much damage it took and what dealt it, with the attacker's id so it can fight back. For example: `Took 8 damage during this action (zombie #19 x2, fall x1); health now 18/20.`

**Fixes**
- Filling buckets from water or lava now works. `use_block` aims at a part of the block it can actually see and right-clicks the way the game does, so buckets, bone meal, hoes and flint and steel behave like a real click. The result also shows the inventory change, so the agent can tell whether it worked.
- `/agent say` answers stay private. The agent was replying to your questions in public chat as you; it now answers in its `[Agent]` lines, which only you see.

**Removed**
- The `send_chat` tool. The agent can't read other players' messages, so posting in public chat as you was more risk than use.

**Other**
- The mod's description and its GitHub links now show in mod menus and launchers.

Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, Fabric API and Java 25.

mods.name: MineAgent
mods.description: Connect a Claude agent to your player with an API key and give it goals to carry out in-game.

releases.notes:
First release of MineAgent, a client-side Fabric mod that lets a language model play your character toward a goal you give it.

**Requires** Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, Fabric API, Java 25.

**Getting started**
1. Put `mineagent-1.0.0.jar` and Fabric API in your `mods` folder.
2. Pick a provider with `/agent provider <id>` and enter its key with `/agent key`.
3. Give a goal: `/agent goal get 3 iron ingots`. `/agent stop` takes control back.

**What's in it**
- Providers: Anthropic (Claude) and any OpenAI-compatible API: OpenAI, DeepSeek, Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, Mistral, xAI, Ollama, or a custom URL.
- 21 tools: observe, find blocks and entities, recipes, walk_to with pathfinding that breaks blocks and pillars up, mine, gather, place, craft (inventory grid or crafting table), smelt, chests, use blocks, equip, eat, attack, collect and drop items, chat, wait.
- Respawns automatically on death and tells the model where and how it died.
- Warns the model about low health, hunger, air, fire and harmful status effects.
- API keys are entered on a masked screen and never go through chat.

See the README for commands, provider settings and limits.
